one_month_reasoning: No TeraWulf earnings in the window: Q3-26 results are expected around Nov 9 (source 20), after Oct 31. In-window items: (1) CB-4 first-hall energization update (targeted late Sept) - likely confirmed, mild +; (2) possible launch of the ~$3.5B Justified debt financing (Morgan Stanley, 'before year-end') - pricing is a credit test, +/-; (3) Anthropic IPO roadshow reportedly in October with Q3 numbers - a sentiment tailwind for Anthropic landlords (WULF, HUT, CIFR), but timing unconfirmed; (4) peer monthly updates, BTC/hashprice (hashprice recovered ~40% since July but mining is <30% of WULF revenue). Against that: stock -13% last week and -50% from June high in lockstep with CIFR/HUT, with insider-sale headlines. Momentum vs. catalyst roughly offset, so I center on spot ($14.85 median) with lognormal monthly sigma ~26% (91%/3.5), symmetric.

fair_value.method: Blend of a DCF of contracted leases plus a probability-weighted pipeline NPV ($9.5/sh, 55%) and 8.5x EV/2029 run-rate contracted revenue of $1.62B less $4.46B net debt over 714M diluted shares ($13.0/sh, 45%) => ~$11.1, valued at Oct-2027.

bear.story: AI-infra de-rating continues (peer group already -50% from June), Justified financing prices wide or slips, CB-5/Justified delays; market values WULF near contracted-only DCF at 10-11% WACC ($5-7) with converts/warrants overhang and further dilution.

base.story: Lake Mariner fully delivered (~430 MW leased), Justified financed and on track for H2-27 first capacity, perhaps one modest new lease; stock trades between my fundamental value (~$11) and peer multiples, with sector beta dominating.

bull.story: Anthropic IPO and AI demand re-rate landlords; WULF signs a 300-500 MW+ Muskie or Morgantown lease toward its 250-500 MW/yr target, and multiple converges toward Cipher/Hut 8 (12-15x 2028 sales).

thesis_break_reason: $8 is roughly the value of contracted leases alone at a 9% WACC with no pipeline credit. Trading there for long would likely mean the market doubts the contracted cash flows themselves (Justified financing failing or a big delay, Fluidstack/Anthropic credit trouble, or a dilutive rescue raise), not just normal 90%-vol swings.

Sector multiple: WULF moves in lockstep with CIFR/HUT; AI-capex sentiment swings dominate fundamentals over 12 months

reasoning: Contracted economics are clear from filings and trade press: ~360 MW Fluidstack at Lake Mariner (~$720M/yr), ~72.5 MW Core42 (~$100M/yr), and 401 MW Anthropic ($19B/20 yrs, ~$950M/yr avg, H2-27 to early-28), so 2029 contracted revenue is about $1.6B. Anthropic's ~$2.4M/MW/yr is above Hut 8's ~$1.86M/MW/yr (Beacon Point/River Bend) and well above Cipher-AWS (~$102/kW-mo), which says WULF's pricing is at the top of the market. The demand chain is strong: Fluidstack raised at $18B, Anthropic has a $65B+ run-rate and reported big compute commitments. But the stock is a leveraged, sector-beta instrument: WULF, CIFR and HUT are all about -45-50% from late-June highs. A DCF of contracted assets gives only ~$6.6/share at 10% WACC (8.1 at 9%) after $5.7B debt, in-the-money converts and 73.6M Google penny warrants; adding a probability-weighted pipeline NPV gives ~$9.5. Peer multiples (WULF 7.7x 2028E sales vs CIFR 12x, HUT 15x) give ~$13. My blended fair value of ~$11.1 is below spot ($14.91), but the market clearly pays for the 1-2 GW pipeline and the 250-500 MW/yr contracting target, and new-lease news is the biggest positive driver. I set the median at ~$13.6 (a modest pull toward fair value from spot) and use lognormal spread with sigma ~0.80 (a bit below 91% realized, since contracted IG-backed revenue grows), giving bear/base/bull of $6.5/$13.5/$27 at 25/50/25. Research limits: Twelve Data stats/estimates and Alpha Vantage were paywalled or rate-limited, so I used no consensus EPS or targets; peer multiples come from one press source (Rallies, Sep 24).
